name: LeafPilot
tagline: An AI LaTeX editor that turns notes or lecture audio into polished documents with embedded animations.
problem: Students spend more time fighting LaTeX formatting than writing content.
solution: Generate and compile LaTeX in the browser, embed math animations, and structure uploaded notes or audio into documents, using fast inference.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a lecture recording and get a typeset PDF with an animation.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Pitched as a familiar pairing: an online LaTeX editor with a coding copilot.

lessons: "X with a copilot" is a fast way to place a tool in judges' heads.
